{{Term/Store|Silver Moblin|Silver Moblins|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI|plural}} are recurring [[Boss]]es and [[Enemy|Enemies]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI}}<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium"/><ref name="TotK Hyrule Compendium"/><ref name="AoC Game Screen"/><ref name="AoI Game Screen"/>

==Characteristics==
==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Compendium/Extract|Silver Moblin}}
Silver Moblins are tall [[Monster]]s that can be found all over [[Hyrule]]. Due to [[Calamity Ganon]]'s magic, they are a powerful variant of [[Moblin]], surpassing even [[Black Moblin]]s, but they are outclassed by [[Golden Moblin]]s.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/> When defeated, they may drop [[Moblin Horn]]s, [[Moblin Fang]]s, [[Moblin Guts]], [[Amber]], [[Opal]], [[Topaz]], [[Ruby|Rubies]], [[Sapphire]]s, and [[Diamond]]s.

==Other Appearances==
==={{AoC|-}}===
{{Improve|April 2023|AoC}}
{{Noncanon|Start}}
Silver Moblins reappear as [[Powerful Foe]]s in {{AoC}}, first appearing in the [[Scenario]] "[[Relentless as a Waterfall]]". During [[Challenge]]s and [[Scenario]]s added in the {{PotA}} [[Downloadable Content]] pack, some can be seen wielding containers with [[Bomb Barrel]]s during battle. A variant that utilizes [[Sky Octorok]]s is also introduced during Scenarios.
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{AoI|-}}===
{{Stub|AoI}}
Silver Moblins can be encountered as [[Powerful Enemy|Powerful Enemies]] in {{AoI}}.
